title: Classification and Matrix for Various Categories of Hospitals (First Revision)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies classification and matrix for five categories of hospitals. It includes the classification according to the functions in alphabetical order with code number, matrix and organizational classification.
clause_3_terminology: Classification and Matrix for Various Categories of Hospitals

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
